title: test_cost_open_session's spool rows use a strftime format Windows rejects
goal: spool_rows in _tools/test_cost_open_session.py writes each row's timestamp with the row's own second (09:00:01, 09:00:02, ...) through a Python format rather than time.strftime with %02d, which Windows rejects with ValueError: Invalid format string and glibc reads as the day of the month, so the 18 tests of test_cost_open_session, _main and _reopened pass on Windows
